question: A circular signboard has a radius of 2 m. If painting costs ₹60 per m² and 10% of the board is left unpainted, what is the total painting cost?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total Cost = (Percentage Painted) × (Area of Circle) × Rate

⇒ Total Cost = 90% × (π × r²) × 60

⇒ Total Cost = 0.9 × 3.14 × 2² × 60

⇒ Total Cost = 0.9 × 12.56 × 60 = 678.24

⇒ Total Cost ≈ ₹678.2

**∴ The correct answer is ₹678.2.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

 

 

 
• 
 
 90% Painted
 10%
 r = 2 m
 Total Cost = Painted Area × Cost per m²

**Given:**

Radius of the circular signboard (r) = 2 m

Cost of painting = ₹60 per m²

Unpainted portion = 10%

**Formula Used:**

Area of a circle = πr²

**Calculation:**

⇒ Total area of the board = 3.14 × 2² = 12.56 m²

⇒ Painted portion = 100% − 10% = 90%

⇒ Area to be painted = 90% of 12.56 = 0.9 × 12.56 = 11.304 m²

⇒ Total cost of painting = Painted area × Cost per m²

⇒ Total cost = 11.304 × 60 = ₹678.24

⇒ Total cost ≈ ₹678.2

**∴ The correct answer is ₹678.2.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Area of a Sector

A sector represents a fraction of the circle. The formula is Area = (θ ÷ 360°) × πr², where θ is the central angle.

Circumference of a Circle

The total length of the boundary of a circle is given by C = 2πr.

Percentage Application in Geometry

Instead of finding the excluded area and subtracting, directly calculate the effective percentage (e.g., 100% − 10% = 90%) and multiply it with the total area.
